mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 2% annualized signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressure and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls below 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below -1% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO growth is below -1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance, which raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 growth is below -1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 6% signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE exceeds 6% (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 3% (t-test p > 0.05).
